purpose: Local player and vehicle efficiency score calculation (0–2000); protected implementation source is not publicly distributed.

declaration.delivery: same-origin local build asset; no remote WASM execution
declaration.function: Calculate the shared efficiency score for player profiles, vehicle records, branches, reports and exported cards.
declaration.inputs: Public aggregate battle statistics supplied by the application; no account credentials.
declaration.output: An efficiency score in the range 0–2000.
declaration.sourceDisclosure: Protected implementation source, coefficients and research materials are not publicly distributed; the declared binary is included for normal platform review.
